verdict.rationale: xAI documents its own self-serve Zero Data Retention control. It is toggleable per team and stops API prompts and outputs from being persisted to disk, with a response header confirming the setting. That is a first-party way to opt out of request-data retention, but no explicit telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-analytics opt-out, documentation on whether metadata or usage is still tracked under ZDR, a training-use opt-out statement, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: ZDR ensures that API request inputs (i.e., your prompt) and outputs ... are never persisted to disk
For teams that require stricter data handling, see [Zero Data Retention (ZDR)]
